date.as_written: nepālavatsare jāte śaśicandragrahānvite, māsi śrāvaṇakṛṣṇasya, trayodaśiyugādaye (!) [...] raviputraś ca (!) vāsare

notes: The chronogram śaśi (1) candra (1) graha (9) represents NS 911. The Newari phrase 'anāthanayā se coṅā jananiyā āsa' refers to the scribe's mother/state of relying on mother/destitution, not a named individual.
